name: charter-wall
prompt: Create one opaque full-bleed wall surface for the boundary of this side-view 2D fighting-game arena, using the attached reference for the exact painted anime/cel-shaded style, ink outlines, materials, colors and top-left afternoon lighting. 1536x1024 landscape. The ENTIRE canvas must be solid architecture, no openings, no sky, no floor, no pillars isolated in empty space, no transparency. Close-up stadium enclosure wall: dark weathered red brick, heavy blue-black iron vertical buttresses with rivets, broad limestone reinforcement bands, a hanging burgundy cloth panel near the center. This is a continuous vertical barrier extending beyond all four canvas edges, not a finished freestanding object. Medium-scale readable surfaces, restrained texture, no text, no characters, no doors or windows. It will be cropped to fill screen-height boundary strips; keep solid detailed masonry at both left and right edges.
